# Bounded refresh of synthetic Slurm attribution fixtures; no live scheduler,
# procfs or GPU is read.
exec nvtelemetry help
stdout 'refresh'

exec nvtelemetry refresh -config refresh.json -count 2
stdout '"cycle":1,"source":"attribution","ready":true'
stdout '"cycle":2,"source":"attribution","ready":true'
stdout '"records":1'
stdout '"withheld":0'
! stdout '"cycle":3'

exec nvtelemetry refresh -config withheld.json -count 1
stdout '"ready":true'
stdout '"records":1'
stdout '"withheld":1'

exec nvtelemetry refresh -config refresh.json -duration 30ms
stdout '"cycle":1,'

# A failed read is reported per cycle and never becomes ready.
exec nvtelemetry refresh -config missing.json -count 1
stdout '"ready":false'
stdout '"error":"attribution refresh: slurm attribution: open squeue-missing.json'

# Refusals happen before any cycle.
! exec nvtelemetry refresh -config refresh.json
stderr 'requires -count or -duration'
! exec nvtelemetry refresh -config unpinned.json -count 1
stderr 'unpinned snapshot'
! stdout .
! exec nvtelemetry refresh -config unknown.json -count 1
stderr 'invalid refresh configuration fields'
! exec nvtelemetry refresh -config managed.json -count 1
stderr 'refresh does not accept managed endpoints'
